name: Margarita: Make Your Story Count
description: Margarita tells the story of an orphaned teenager with a life like a movie, with many doubts and almost no certainty about her story, who, following her wish, will arrive at a very magical place where she can live and fulfill her dreams, without knowing that this house was the place where she was born and that the perfidious Delfina usurped it to build her empire.

videos.title: A Storybook Tale
videos.overview: Margarita grows up without realizing her true identity -- until a scholarship opportunity at Hangar Soho thrusts her into an exciting new life.

videos.title: The Queen of Garbage
videos.overview: At the Hangar Soho auditions, Margarita manages to impress her peers and Delfina, who is threatened by her presence.

videos.title: Sad Music Video
videos.overview: After escaping the set of the sad music video, Margarita returns to the Fritzenwalden mansion, where she gets to know the rest of the scholars.

videos.title: The Thistles
videos.overview: While Margarita gleans information about her mother's identity, the scholarship recipients work together, and Delfina learns the truth.

videos.title: Romeo's Place
videos.overview: After a crisis at the magazine, Delfina gives the scholars an impossible challenge -- until Margarita formulates a plan.

videos.title: Unique and Chosen
videos.overview: To find Margarita, Delfina decides to disqualify a scholar and announce a new challenge that brings out Única's competitive side.

videos.title: Flíquiti
videos.overview: When Margarita takes to the internet to explain how she took Pez Eléctrico's place, Delfina believes the heir has uncovered her true identity.

videos.title: Lie Truth
videos.overview: While a defeated Delfina decides to turn herself in, Margarita interferes with Rey's plans for Merlín.

videos.title: Toxic Waste
videos.overview: After catching Margarita in an intimate moment with Merlín, Rey blackmails her into starring in his music video.

videos.title: What We Want and What We Need
videos.overview: While a paranoid Delfina hires Germán to investigate threats of extortion, drama flares at the Hangar Soho pool.

videos.title: Karaoke
videos.overview: Margarita recalls her first heartbreak after catching Daisy and Merlín together. Delfina receives a terrifying message.

videos.title: Climate Change
videos.overview: While Margarita and Daisy worry over his whereabouts, Merlín goes to Krikoragán with Pio Pietro and Erasmus.

videos.title: Traffic Light
videos.overview: Delfina finally reveals Daisy's true identity, while Margarita confronts Única after a winning performance.

videos.title: Slumber Party
videos.overview: While Margarita struggles to watch Daisy and Merlín together, Ada overhears shocking information from Delfina.

videos.title: An Unexpected Turn
videos.overview: As Delfina and Severino get closer to uncovering the hacker's identity, the group of scholars are unexpectedly swept away to Costa Diamante.

videos.title: Someone Is in Trouble (1)
videos.overview: After their plane lands, the group bands together to ensure their survival -- all while scandal brews in the real world.

videos.title: Someone Is in Trouble (2)
videos.overview: While Delfina receives praise for her work with the scholars, the group realizes that their island exploits are being filmed.

videos.title: Political Asylum
videos.overview: As the group dynamic deteriorates, Margarita comes up with a solution that could turn Hangar Soho into an embassy.

videos.title: Private Lives
videos.overview: With the group overwhelmed by the spotlight, Delfina suggests disconnecting the cameras ... leading to several revelations amongst the group.

videos.title: Another Princess in the Palace
videos.overview: While Salo organizes a dinner show at the Hangar, Merlín's fiancée, Petra, shows up at the mansion seeking political asylum.

videos.title: Little Weed
videos.overview: While Margarita's anger towards Delfina grows, tensions within the Hangar group reach an all-time high.

videos.title: Hunches
videos.overview: As the competition for the new scholarships narrows, Merlín plans to protest against the monarchy, and Margarita searches for clues to her past.

videos.title: Fiction or Reality
videos.overview: Amid the chaos at Hangar, Mei's mother wants to take her home, Merlín comes clean to Daisy, and Yamila extracts an important confession from Malala.

videos.title: Canceled
videos.overview: As Margarita struggles with getting "canceled," Delfina presents the magazine of the month -- and reveals the scholarship winners.

videos.title: The Cards of Destiny
videos.overview: Before announcing an elimination, the hacker blackmails Delfina into keeping Margarita in the competition.

videos.title: Fairy in Love
videos.overview: While Margarita begins a secret new relationship, the hacker warns Delfina that her lies will soon be released to the public.

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: After being attacked by Rano and his partner, Margarita must choose between her two loves: Merlín and Rey.

videos.title: Another Stone in the Path
videos.overview: While Margarita continues to deal with her feelings for both Rey and Merlín, Delfina and Severino pressure the hacker to plan a kidnapping.

videos.title: As the Saying Goes
videos.overview: On a spa day outside of the city, Delfina starts to open up to Margarita. Back at the mansion, Malala settles in.

videos.title: Faces and Masks
videos.overview: After Pipe, Zeki, Jano and Julieta discover the hacker's identity, Delfina returns to the mansion -- only to face an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: On Time
videos.overview: When Mei's health takes a turn for the worse, the scholars prepare a presentation to raise awareness about organ donation.

videos.title: DNA or ID
videos.overview: Ada finds hard evidence about the true princess, Merlín moves forward with renouncing his titles, and Mei returns to Hangar.

videos.title: The Heirs
videos.overview: Ada is determined to tell Margarita and Daisy the truth. Delfina's Future Patron award gives her a new sense of purpose.

videos.title: The Princess Who Lives in the Heart of the People (1)
videos.overview: While Delfina finds herself cornered, Margarita and Merlín fly to Krikoragán, where she quickly wins the affection of her subjects.

videos.title: The Princess Who Lives in the Heart of the People (2)
videos.overview: In Krikoragán, Margarita and Merlín's relationship is quickly exposed to the public, leading to viral fame and an ultimatum from Erasmus.

videos.title: Under the Marquis' Cape
videos.overview: Despite Merlín's announcement, Erasmus accelerates plans to eliminate Margarita. In Hangar, Delfina focuses on receiving her award.

videos.title: The Great Answer
videos.overview: After avoiding a harrowing mid-flight attack, Margarita receives life-changing news about her past from a newly escaped Ada.

videos.title: Without Words
videos.overview: After learning of her true identity, Margarita attempts to lie low -- until she uncovers Anieta's DVD recording.

videos.title: To Win or to Lose
videos.overview: Delfina finally announces the winner of the contest, Ada encourages Margarita to escape with Daisy, and Merlín leaves for Krikoragán.

videos.title: Last Chapter
videos.overview: Delfina sets her plan into action by preparing to forcibly send Margarita away -- until Fach reappears with a shocking revelation.

videos.title: I Say Magic (1)
videos.overview: While Delfina takes the world by storm with a new streaming platform, Margarita and Fach make it to Krikoragán for the royal wedding.

videos.title: I Say Magic (2)
videos.overview: While Merlín and Margarita reunite to escape Krikoragán, Delfina expands her digital empire with an AI-generated Margarita.

videos.title: I Will Escape
videos.overview: Delfina's digital moves cause a stir, Ada attempts to rescue Pipe, and Margarita and Merlín escape with rebel help.

videos.title: Oh La La
videos.overview: While Delfina deals with Daisy, Fach moves closer to an important lead, and Margarita uncovers the full scale of Delfina's plan.

videos.title: Nothing but Fiction
videos.overview: While an accidental livestream draws suspicion from Delfina, Fach escapes Krikoragán, and Yamila exposes AI Margarita.

videos.title: Musical Fantasy
videos.overview: Now in Argentina, tensions brew amongst Margarita and her crew. Meanwhile, Delfina tightens her control over REINA.

videos.title: Our Essence
videos.overview: After revealing the truth to her friends, Margarita and her crew decide to fight back with their own platform. Meanwhile, Delfina expands her reach.

videos.title: And Who Are You?
videos.overview: As FLÍKITI grows in popularity, Delfina does whatever it takes to maintain her dominance. Later, Merlín faces his mother’s arrest.

videos.title: Anything Can Happen
videos.overview: Margarita and Fach escape Reina Studios, the League plans a rescue, and an increasingly paranoid Delfina sets her sights on Ada and Pipe.

videos.title: Points of View
videos.overview: While the League's rescue exposes the regime, Delfina struggles with FLÍKITI's rise, and Margarita’s bond with Merlín becomes strained.

videos.title: Upside Down World
videos.overview: After Daisy is promoted to princess, Erasmus threatens to expose her. Later, Merlín learns the truth about Margarita and Rey.

videos.title: The Cost of the Truth
videos.overview: When Erasmus exposes Daisy's true identity, Delfina scrambles to maintain control. Meanwhile, Margarita decides to confront Delfina on her own.

videos.title: Familiar
videos.overview: Under pressure to reveal her identity, Margarita puts Daisy first. The League develops a cunning plan, and Delfina comes close to the truth.

videos.title: Viral
videos.overview: Delfina finds the group's hideout, Malala's viral exposé fuels the ongoing scandal, and Única uncovers the AI Margarita.

videos.title: Take a Chance
videos.overview: Though Delfina emerges victorious through tampered DNA, Margarita gears up for a public confrontation, and doubts about Fach divide the group.

videos.title: Intuition's Plans
videos.overview: Margarita bursts into REINA, Fach searches for evidence about his brother, and the group plans to expose Delfina, who counterattacks with a low blow.

videos.title: He Who Laughs Last
videos.overview: The group reorganizes to defeat Delfina, the news about Pio Pietro shakes Krikoragan, and Fach seeks a DNA test for Florencio.

videos.title: The Mysterious Woman
videos.overview: Amid the confusion surrounding Andrés, the group and Delfina exchange barbs. Later, Ada and Pipe reveal the truth to Daisy.

videos.title: King of Everything
videos.overview: As suspicions about Rey grow, Daisy confronts Margarita. Later, Ada manages to escape, a lawsuit against Delfina moves forward, and the tactics of both sides escalate the conflict until the police intervene.

videos.title: Who Tell the Story
videos.overview: When the plan to expose Delfina fails, she manipulates the narrative to frame Severino. Then, while Margarita decides to place her trust in Rey, Daisy struggles to accept the truth, and Delfina delivers a stunning final blow.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: TBA August 2026
